notes:
OCRelay 1.0.96

TWO NEW STUDIES

• OB Ultrasound → 2nd/3rd Trimester (Limited) — the compact worksheet, including cervical length (accepts free text such as "Not well visualized") and a maternal-uterus advisory banner.

• Liver Elastography — the EQI stiffness table. METAVIR staging is shown in the review panel as an advisory only, on both the GE and Philips velocity scales, with an IQR/Median quality note. The IMPRESSION line is never written.

FEWER MISSED VALUES

• The review panel now reads the open PS360 report and tells you up front if any value has no matching line — so a wrong-template mismatch is caught before the paste instead of after.

• The result after a fill now reports against everything that was read. Previously a partial fill could show "8/8 confirmed" in green while values were silently dropped; it now names what didn't land.

• Implausible values are highlighted in the review panel — a slipped decimal (26.5 read as 265) is flagged before it reaches the report. Advisory only; nothing is blocked or auto-corrected.

FOLLOWS POWERSCRIBE 360

• When a new template loads in PS360, the Study picker switches to match it. Turn this off under Settings → Studies.

• Auto-detect is no longer the default for new installs and now sits at the bottom of the study list.

NEW: ACCURACY REPORT

• Settings → Tools → Accuracy Report shows how often each field had to be corrected and what the corrections were, so prompt improvements can be aimed at real problems. Entirely local — nothing is sent anywhere.

FIXES

• Pasted values are no longer bold in PS360.

• Recall Last now restores the worksheet warning banners, not just the measurements.

• The PS360 template watch no longer stops working after the first review of a session.

• First run on a multi-monitor workstation no longer captures the wrong screen.

• Carotid captures no longer raise a false "values not placed" warning for plaque and vertebral findings.
